title: _figure_meta.json
description: Provenance for drawings, schematics, publisher figures and generated illustrations. One file per asset folder, keyed by filename. Validated by scripts/check_assets.py.

shows.description: what the figure depicts and what it labels

declared_as_drawing_on_page.description: REQUIRED true when the figure depicts something no camera can see - the page must say on its face that it is a drawing

generated_by.description: generated illustrations: the model or tool

generation_brief.description: generated illustrations: path to the GENERATED_ASSET brief this was produced from

depicts_what_no_photograph_can.description: generated illustrations: the justification for generating rather than photographing

sourced_values.description: charts: every plotted value with its source

interpolation_marked.description: charts: interpolated points are visually distinguished from sourced ones

RIGHTS.description: free-text rights warning carried through from the source, if any
